name: InfluxDB 3 Core Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free MIT/Apache-2.0 open-source single-node time-series database software with no license fees, usage fees, or telemetry requirement; self-hosted storage and compute are user-provided.
watch_out: Core queries approximately 72 hours of data by default due to Parquet query-file limits; high availability, multi-node and enterprise features require paid products. Own server, storage and object-storage costs apply; not a free managed cloud tier.
